svg.text: Open top: smoke and CO₂ out;
cap loosely with sod/iron when done
larger pieces low, smaller on top
Stoke / draw arch: feed wood for
2–4 days; rake out lime when cool
Typical: 3 m³ (≈100 ft³) charge ≈ 1.6 t stone + 1.4 t dry wood → ≈0.9 t quicklime (Practical Action Dedza kiln). Never stand on the charge or lean over the top while burning.
